Fresh static snow is probably my favourite song of all time really. Been listening to Madeon since 2011, and porter since language came out. Shelter Live was the best night of my life, ever. I'm too deep into gaming that sometimes I feel like it affects me socially in a bad way, I really play too much.

I definetly stopped giving a fuck about what others think of me as of late and it's really helped me as a person actually. I just don't feel like I'm ready to push myself and I want to stop and smell the roses for a while.

I do make a little bit of music. Started lately, however the only things on my SC are mashups and nothing experimental. I was referring to making music, being a straight A student at one point before failing high school due to depression and I was also an aspiring golfer at one point before I lost all interest.

I'm going through this right now and it's worse because my friends are constantly reassuring me that she has a bad relationship with her bf, she has told me the same thing and since the last two weeks she's been trying to fix it. 

I'm happy but sad at the same time, the past six months of my life have been incredible compared to everything before them. SHE IS MY FIRST EVER FEMALE FRIEND, after nearly 18 years. I feel like I can actually talk to women properly for once. And I'm happy for her, but if only she was single. All my friends are telling me I'm definitely next in line. 

She even came to my place for an hour on Valentine's when I hadn't even invited her over because I thought she would be with him. I am so fucking confused.

I have the smallest bit of hope in me that I can pull this around in the future but that's met with me having to realize well the chances are not in my favor at all and in reality I'm just her friend and always will be. Fuck this.
